A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
D14BMb is a strong adverse feature in patients treated with VDAD but is not an adverse feature in patients receiving more intensive therapy with HCVAD.
D7PBb is associated with poor outcome, and D14BM is associated with poor prognosis only in the setting of a suboptimal treatment.

the persistence of peripheral blood and marrow blasts after induction chemotherapy in adult ALL is an independent adverse prognostic factor for patients treated with less intensive chemotherapy regimens, but not for those treated with more intensive regimens.
The main takeaway from our work is that
persistence of D7PB and D14BM are adverse prognostic features in adult ALL.
early clearance of leukemia cells is important for outcome, and the timing of clearance is important.
